entities.summary: Julius Adolph Stöckhardt was a German agricultural chemist. He is mostly recognized for his work on fertilizers, fume damage of plants and his book Die Schule der Chemie, which was translated into 14 languages. His 500 lectures and over 500 publications helped to establish agricultural chemistry in Germany.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julius Adolph Stöckhardt was a German agricultural chemist. He is mostly recognized for his work on fertilizers, fume damage of plants and his book Die Schule der Chemie, which was translated into 14 languages. His 500 lectures and over 500 publications helped to establish agricultural chemistry in Germany.
